So `|| p.path`, `true` and `"adr"` -> `""` all leave the filter equal to `p.path` for every pointer the grammar yields. Measured: 0 of 21 cases differ, including `props` (ADR-only, file plus ADR, test pointer, missing file, directory) and `sig`.
